description: AI assist (nnInteractive) at the session moment after step 31: prompts on the slice, the 3D answer (k 5-13, the journal's step 32′) as a CA1 proposal reviewed slice by slice, a two-line bar, over-reach checked on the slice and the ruler
decisions: The state is session.ts as of step 31 (as the licence gate) with the first answer pending: nine slices k 5-13, k 11, 10 and 12 looked at, exactly the branch step 32′ that history keeps.
Per-slice accept is the default: 'Accept CA1 here ↵' writes k 11 and steps to the next unseen slice (k 9); 'Confirm all 9…' is a quiet secondary alone on the right.
The bar is two lines: progress (pips, '3 of 9 slices seen', 'then k 9', voxels, provider) and four actions (Accept, Discard, prompt undo as an icon with ⌥Z in its tooltip, Confirm all…).

Over-reach: one halo tag on the slice below the structure ('check 7 vx · ERC 4, empty · Subiculum 3') beside the neutral voxel outline; empty labels are checked against the prior's territory within 5 mm; answer slices outside the body slab (k 5) get their own 'check' run on the ruler. The kept count is in the key's tooltip.

Orthogonal views: CA1 as the session had it (fill), the answer past it in a coarser CA1 hatch with one outline around the whole answer; the axial view marks the proposed slab k 5-13 (faint tilted band between hairlines).
The CA1 island keeps its ring and the inline 'island' key.
mocked: The model's answer on this slice is the mock CA1 still to trace plus a one-voxel rim, gated by the real rule; on other slices it is the mock CA1 on the slices empty at step 31; ERC's prior territory is the template example; no server is called.

description: First-use licence gate, shown at the moment before AI was first used (session step 31): no AI marks anywhere; one sentence of what is recorded, the record behind 'Show record'
decisions: The ruler is the session as of step 31 (session.ts, asOf): CA1 k 8-10 and 12-14 were not traced yet and nothing is marked AI.
Local server selected and open; the remote option is one line with its warning icon (what leaves in the tooltip) until selected.
Recorded: one plain sentence; the JSON record behind 'Show record'. Lab policy can pre-acknowledge; a new licence version reopens the gate.
mocked: Server status, version and URL are mock; nothing is contacted.

description: WMH on a mock FLAIR, outline only, while L1's type is set: T1w and T2w at the primary's exact scale in the side column, seed rows with types printed only when not WMH, span and mm³ bars, Fazekas provisional
decisions: WMH is outline only by default (no inset fill); the brush preview is the only fill; 'Outline only' shows as on.

While a type is set (row open), T1w over T2w (real templates) replace the coronal/sagittal cuts, drawn at the primary's centre and px-per-mm and cropped to the tile: true small multiples. No strip below the primary and no whole-slice tile (Fit, Z, is the overview), so the FLAIR has its height back.
Rows came from an imported LST-AI seed as unreviewed rows; a row prints its type only when it is not WMH; the span axis is labelled once ('k 113 → 84'), the per-row axis rule lightened.
Each row: a span bar on the ruler's axial-k axis with the current k marked, and a mm³ bar on one scale.
Fazekas periventricular and deep per subject, 'provisional · 4 lesions to review' while rows are unreviewed; connectivity '26-connected' in the protocol line.
mocked: FLAIR is a mock made from the 1 mm MNI152 T1w template (non-monotonic intensity map, blur, noise); the six lesions are synthetic blobs with a partial-volume membership (tools/design/segmentation_flair_assets.py). T1w and T2w are the real templates on the same slice; the LST-AI seed is the mock mask itself.
Same mock FLAIR and synthetic lesions as state lesion.
description: Lesions at fit: the whole axial FLAIR slice in the primary with every lesion tag (Z toggles back to L1)
decisions: Fit (Z) and 'L1 · 3.7×' are one segmented control in the header.
Every lesion on the slice is outlined and tagged as halo text at one tag size (as at L1 zoom); reviewed lesions quiet, the current active.
The side column shows the coronal and sagittal cuts through L1 with the axial band at 0.30 and edge hairlines (visible at tile scale); the type row stays closed.
No brush and no range strip at fit; the Inspector keeps the list, seed and Fazekas.

description: Contrast aids after a quiet ⌘S: square T1w lens with a 1 px rim and halo caption, the view-only filter badge, the island key inline, 'Saved 14:33' in the header
decisions: The lens is a square window (never read as the island ring), 1 px neutral rim over a halo, its caption as halo text below the rim.
The island ring keeps its inline key on header line 2.
⌘S wrote silently to the remembered path: the session header says 'Saved 14:33', no sheet.
Flicker keys V raw, T T1w (Space stays pan); a filter on a stroke is recorded in provenance; a pack-set filter would badge 'set by pack'.
View aids is one line ('display only · never written · filters recorded') with the rest behind '?'; the filter and lens switches show on while they show.
mocked: The filter is the generator's view-only unsharp mask of the template T2w; T1w is the template T1w.

description: History dock at 8 rows (about a quarter of the primary, resizable and collapsible) with signed vx bars, the kept branch as one row with its AI status and Restore
decisions: One step count: '17 steps since the 14:02 save · 1 kept branch' in the dock header only (the session header says 'unsaved since 14:02', the status bar the journal's age, Autosave its size); the same 17 resume recovers and save reports.
The kept branch (32′ AI confirm all, 33′ eraser) is one row at its branch point: '6 not reviewed', Restore… warns that it brings them back.
Signed vx bars on one scale beside each count; label and k filters in the dock header.
Steps confirmed without a look say '· 1 not reviewed' (AI k 9) and '· 2 not reviewed' (fill between k 12-13), matching the ruler's hollow marks.
A row prints its label's name only where it changes from the row above; the swatch stays.
mocked: Steps, times, sizes and voxel sets are mock; per-label undo counts come from the real rule on mock voxel sets.

description: Save as / export…: ⌘S saves silently; the sheet's sections are one line each, dseg.tsv the only default table, a draft warning for unreviewed slices, one sentence of what is recorded
decisions: Title 'Save as / export…'; ⌘S writes the same files to the remembered path without the sheet.
Label volume, label table and provenance collapse to one summary line each; dseg.tsv is the only default table (ITK-SNAP and FreeSurfer LUT opt-in, FreeSurfer ids mapped by name).
Unreviewed slices warn and save as status draft; only Mark complete waits.
Provenance codes: manual, interpolated reviewed / not reviewed, AI reviewed / not reviewed, from the session model, summing to the labelled voxels.
BIDS: ses and a rater desc, no space entity (SpatialReference in the sidecar), the provenance volume has its own suffix.
mocked: Paths, hash, times and software version are mock; table previews come from the real writers on the mock label table.

description: Reopening after a crash: 17 recovered steps (22-38, the same journal as history), the last edit outlined with a halo-text tag
decisions: Counts come from the session model: recovered = steps since the last save.
'last edit · 14:31' is halo text beside the stroke, no chip; the island key is inline.
After the first stroke the banner collapses to one line and 'Show changes' (stepping through history hover outlines) stays until the next save.
mocked: The crash, the journal and the times are mock.

description: Session setup with the registration check in the primary: T1w in 8 mm squares over T2w at tracing zoom over the hippocampus, 'Aligned' unticked with the confirmer recorded; a 200 px slab locator; Add label collapsed
decisions: Subject/session/hemisphere/rater fields name the files; blinding hides other raters' labels until submission.
The grid choice shows the 20-slice slab tilted 30° on a 200 px sagittal T2w, k 20 and k 1 labelled outside the slab's ends.

Registration: while section 3 is open the primary is the check (checkerboard, with T1w edges and flicker as alternatives), at tracing zoom over the hippocampus, squares anchored to the image; 'Aligned at the hippocampus' starts unticked and records the confirmer, time, transform hash and view; 'Not aligned…' re-registers or traces without T1w aids; Start tracing waits for it.
'+ Add label' is collapsed; when open, only offered colours show, the refused ones behind one line.
mocked: The palette, the pack and the new label (Fimbria, id 7) are mock; T1w and T2w are the templates, so the checkerboard shows a perfect registration.
